text:
Looking for a new roommate (May 1st move-in) for the second bedroom in our apartment and seeking a dog-friendly person, as we have a rescue pup (17-month-old) named Benny. (This does not mean you have to take care of a dog. He goes to daycare Mon-Fri till about 8 pm and is with me in my room when I'm home. If I'm ever out, he is left in my room, where he naps without whining.)

About the building: This is a secure building located in Bushwick, a block or two away from the Williamsburg border. There is an elevator, parking, a courtyard, and a gym. It's been here since 2008 & there are longtime owners and tenants, so it's well kept.
About the room: You will have your own bathroom, which I have just had a brand-new toilet installed. (You also have the larger bathroom.) About the apartment: It is a 2-bedroom, 2-bath apartment with a shared living room and dining room. I have a washer and dryer, a dishwasher, and a small terrace with a pretty cool view of Manhattan. I'm on the top floor (7th).

About the furniture: It includes a full-size bed, a desk, a TV, and a few small dressers. (We can talk about moving in your furniture, if you like.) There is a closet with a pretty high ceiling.

Regarding the lease, I am flexible. My last boarders (from The Listings Project and the other from Facebook) had three-month leases. One was a doctoral student, and the current one is a law student!

ONE MONTH DEPOSIT REQUIRED. A credit check (which I conduct), proof of income, and a reference would be greatly appreciated.
About us: Working professionals (I actually work in higher ed, which is why I like to rent to students, but am open to working professionals, too! I work one day a week at home, the rest in the office! My boyfriend works in human services and fitness and is out of the house every single day.) We are usually pretty quiet at home. Not the type to bring the party home. We like to cook a few weeknights each week.

I am the owner/landlord.
Rent is $2150 per month with utilities included.
